name: Fraga (Spain)
description: Green field charged at the centre with the crowned arms of the city of Fraga (a tree on white and the bars of Aragon, inscribed VENCEDORA Y FIDELÍSIMA CIUDAD DE FRAGA, timbred with a bat).
history: The flag of Fraga is rectangular, plain green (medium green) with the arms of the city at its centre; the arms are timbred with a bat and above it the royal crown.

features.role: Fraga arms — tree on white and the bars of Aragon within an inscribed bordure, timbred with a bat beneath the crown
